faqs.a: Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$250 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.

faqs.q: Is it really fee-free?
faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: Which assets can I trade?
faqs.a: 9 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

bottomLine: Vertex Trust Capital is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.
The scorecard settles at 4.5. That is a cautious pass - proceed with the demo first, the minimum deposit second, and treat every payout figure as unproven until you see it yourself.

faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

bottomLine: The platform itself is workable - the dashboard, the demo and the two trading modes are all present. The caution applies to the claims around them, not the mechanics.
